stories.title: Middle East supply risks overshadow Russian diesel deal
stories.summary: The US-Russia energy deal aims to increase Russian diesel exports and halt attacks on energy infrastructure, but market reactions remain uncertain amid ongoing conflicts and domestic pressures in Russia and Ukraine.

stories.title: TotalEnergies, KKR Add 700 MW to US Solar JV
stories.summary: TotalEnergies and KKR agreed to expand their 50:50 solar joint venture in the United States to 2,100 megawatts.

stories.title: Matador Completes Ridge Runner Acquisition from EnCap
stories.summary: Matador Resources completed the acquisition of two portfolio companies of EnCap Investments that are operating in the Delaware Basin.

stories.title: CHS breaks ground on new soybean-processing facility in Evansville, Wisconsin
stories.summary: The facility is expected to process 80 million bushels of soybeans annually, producing 1 billion pounds of soybean oil and 2 million tons of soybean meal.

stories.title: NOPA applauds congressional push for timely supplemental RFS rule

stories.title: IRFA appreciates Iowa delegation’s call to restore waived RFS gallons

stories.title: Reps. Smith, Budzinski lead letter urging Trump administration to support America’s biofuel industry
stories.summary: The lawmakers ask the administration to propose by Oct. 16 a supplemental rule that preserves the integrity of RFS volume requirements.
